title: Romeo and Juliet
author: William Shakespeare
summary: In Verona, the teenage children of two feuding families, Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet, fall in love and marry in secret. Their families' hatred pushes events toward tragedy within a few days.
readIf: you want the original tragic love story in poetic language, ideally read aloud or staged.
skipIf: you struggle with Elizabethan language and dislike plays in script form.
